description: NPS-2010-emails educational forensic corpus. FAT16 E01 disk image containing 26 files with email addresses embedded in 7 application/encoding format families. Created by Simson Garfinkel, Naval Postgraduate School.

artifacts.description: FAT16 macOS disk image, 10 MB, 26 files, 7 format families. Makefile confirms synthetic construction by Simson Garfinkel (NPS). No actual user data. Educational corpus.

strings output: 9/26 email addresses recovered. 17/26 absent. Recovery gap explained by FlateDecode PDF compression, OOXML ZIP, UTF-16 null bytes, iWork ZIP, nested GZIP/ZIP. Format barriers, not anti-forensics.

E01 entropy H=7.95 (HIGH). Expected for EWF format compression stacking with compressed file content (OOXML, PDF, iWork, GZIP). OLE .doc entropy H=3.04 (NORMAL). Differential confirms format-driven entropy, not encryption.

UTF-16 LE encoding confirmed (BOM ff fe on document3.txt). Null bytes between characters break strings default ASCII detection. Standard macOS TextEdit encoding. Recoverable via strings -e l or iconv.
artifacts.source: hex inspection of document3.txt + iconv verification

artifacts.description: OLE .doc and .xls files: email addresses recoverable by strings. H=3.04. Uncompressed binary compound storage. user_doc@microsoftword.com appears twice (HYPERLINK field + body text). xls_cell and xls_comment also recovered. Consistent with OLE format specification.
4 artifact hashes stable. E01=c9ffd969, strings=07c0fd1c, txt=bf22eb2a, zip=94d84f69. Chain of custody intact. No tampering detected. Educational corpus from NPS consistent with known distribution.
